description: Make a professional invoice PDF and get a link to it. Send the line items and rates; Platemark does the math (subtotal, discount, tax, shipping, amount paid, amount due) in exact cents and formats money for the currency. Returns the PDF link, page count and the totals it used. Costs 2 credits.

accent.description: Hex color for the title and total, like #1d4ed8.

amount_paid.description: Already paid, subtracted from the total.

currency.description: ISO code like USD, EUR, GBP. Default USD.

due_days.description: Days after the issue date, if no due_date. 30 means Net 30.

address.description: Street, city and so on, separated by line breaks or commas.

unit_price.description: Price of one unit, in the invoice currency.

locale.description: Like en-US or de-DE, for date and number formats.

name: render_invoice
title: Make an invoice PDF
